doc.title: Crescent City Crystals: Dave Bailey, Harold Christophe, Albert Delone, Sylvester Handy Interview, 1963-11-13

chapter: Dave Bailey: recording and learning to play
title: Other bands played with and learning drums on tubs, tin pans and boxes
summary: Bailey lists Chris Kelly, Sam Moore, Buddy Pete, Joe Alva and Jack Carey, says he learned on tubs and tin pans, and describes learning to read drum music.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Reading music versus faking and playing by ear
